items.stem: What should you always do with metadata that Gemini drafts before publishing it?

options.text: Review and edit it for accuracy and policy compliance
options.rationale: Correct: generated metadata can contain errors or policy issues and must be checked by a human.

options.text: Publish it unchanged to save time
options.rationale: Unreviewed generated text may be inaccurate or violate policy.

options.text: Delete it and always rewrite everything by hand
options.rationale: The draft is a useful starting point; wholesale rewriting is unnecessary.

options.text: Translate it to another language first
options.rationale: Translation does not address accuracy or policy review.

items.explanation: Correct: generated metadata can contain errors or policy issues and must be checked by a human.

items.stem: Which TWO YouTube Studio metrics best help you judge whether a video performed well? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: CTR reflects how well the title and thumbnail attract clicks.
Correct: AVD reflects whether the content kept viewers watching.
A channel-wide total does not isolate one video's performance.
The upload time is metadata, not a performance signal.

items.explanation: Correct: CTR reflects how well the title and thumbnail attract clicks.

items.stem: In Sheets, which function best pulls the matching view count for a given video ID from an exported data tab?

options.rationale: Correct: a lookup function matches the video ID and returns its view count.
SUM adds a range; it does not match by key.
CONCATENATE joins text; it does not look up values.

items.explanation: Correct: a lookup function matches the video ID and returns its view count.
